items.q: What is the real bottleneck once agents write most of the code?
items.a: **Trusting the agent's done**: you can't review the volume, so **verification has to be automated**.

items.q: Why isn't an agent saying tests pass enough?
items.a: Its report is **model prose, not evidence**; status should **come from records** like screenshots and test output.

items.q: What bug does a UI-only check miss in the workshop demo?
items.a: The form shows success but **never persists the email**; a reload reveals it, so **check the other half**.

items.q: What is the highest-leverage first step for agent verification in a web app?
items.a: A **custom verifier CLI** that lets any agent **drive and inspect the app** like a developer would.

items.q: What verbs does the snack verifier offer?
items.a: **doctor** for health, drive actions, **snapshot/storage/console/screenshot** to look, and **prove/judge** to check.

items.q: Why use one command instead of prose verification instructions?
items.a: Thirty agents given the same prompt vary; **one bash-backed command is uniform** and deterministic.

items.q: When do you use a fast model as judge?
items.a: For fuzzy checks like wording, so tests **aren't tightly coupled** to exact text; deterministic **prove** handles the rest.

items.q: How should you tell an agent what to build?
items.a: Give the **end state and the check**: you'll know you're done when **this command returns this**.

items.q: Why not prescribe every step to a frontier model?
items.a: Over-prescribing can **lower performance**; given room it **catches more edge cases** and asks useful questions.

items.q: What loop should the agent run on a bug?
items.a: **Reproduce, fix, then prove**: red-green-refactor with the verifier as the **stop condition**.

items.q: Why do error messages matter more with agents?
items.a: Agents read them well, so **explicit errors let them self-heal** without a human nudge.
**Screenshots, recordings of the user journey, test and smoke output** attached to the PR or stored.

items.q: Why keep receipts after the PR merges?
items.a: They become **eval data for self-improving loops**, a growing advantage over teams that **didn't save runs**.

items.q: How do you make every agent on a team verify?
items.a: Put **on change, run the verifier** in **AGENTS.md**, then back it with shared hooks and CI.
A **rollout agent** that monitors metrics and feature flags and **reverts when things go bad**.
